statement: A directly supplied aspect contributes one merged readEach callback data object, including when constructed from nested aspects.
scenario: Given data traits A={x:1}, B={y:2}, C={z:3}, a complete entity and Outer=createAspect(createAspect(A,B),C), readEach on a query with Outer as its only parameter supplies state with one element: {x:1,y:2,z:3}.
